At a swimming pool in Los Angeles,children
are taught to hold their breath under water
before they can walk. They begin learning
when they are two months old and,in time,
they can pick up weights from the bottom of
the pool. The game they enjoy most is the
tricycle race, which takes place seven feet
under water. Some children pedal their
tricycles, while others push or pull them, and
a few get across without coming up for far.
